name: Sweden

train.sum: Stockholm Central (Stockholm C) is the hub for SJ high-speed and InterCity trains, MTR Express, regional Mälartåg trains, SL commuter trains and night trains to northern Sweden. International trains run to Copenhagen, Hamburg, Oslo and Berlin.
train.sched: SJ trains to Gothenburg run about hourly and trains to Malmö roughly hourly. Trains to Uppsala leave many times a day. Night trains run to Åre, Umeå and Luleå.
tickets: SJ fares work like airline fares: cheapest when booked early. Tickets go on sale up to 6 months ahead
Seat reservations are included in 1st and 2nd class tickets on SJ Snabbtåg and InterCity trains
Children aged 0 to 15 get 15% off the adult fare. Pensioners aged 65 and over get about 10% off
Stockholm to Gothenburg: SJ about hourly, and MTR Express is a competitor with its own tickets
Snälltåget day train to Hamburg: fares from 499 SEK. Reservations are required on Snälltåget and night trains
SL commuter trains (pendeltåg) are covered by SL tickets
train.tip: Buy your ticket before you board. SJ stopped selling tickets on its trains in 2012, so use the SJ app or sj.se.
buy: SJ app or sj.se (seat is assigned when you book)
Ticket machines at Stockholm Central
Not sold on board SJ trains. Buy before you board
Snälltåget: boka.snalltaget.se
Night trains and Snälltåget need a reservation
Commuter trains: SL app, or a bank card tap at the gates

destinations.note: SJ night train takes about 9 h 20 min and leaves around 22:40
Daily day train, calls at Copenhagen Syd. SJ high-speed trains take about 5 h 15 min when they run, see sj.se
Night train with a new schedule from 13 December 2026

tram.sum: SL runs the Tunnelbana (metro), buses, trams, commuter trains and some ferries on one ticket. Tram 7 and bus 69 serve Djurgården, and SL ferries run from Slussen and Nybroviken to Djurgården.
tram.sched: The Metro runs from about 05:00 to 01:00, and on Friday and Saturday nights it runs all night about every 30 minutes. By day trains come every 4 to 6 minutes. Check the SL app for exact times.
tickets: Single ticket: 43 SEK, valid 75 minutes on metro, bus, tram, commuter train and selected ferries
24-hour ticket: 180 SEK. 72-hour ticket: 360 SEK. 7-day ticket: 470 SEK
Reduced single ticket: 26 SEK for children, teenagers and students up to age 20, and seniors
A bank card tap at the gates charges the 43 SEK single fare each time
No valid ticket: 1,500 SEK penalty fee. Unaccompanied children under 15 are not fined
tram.tip: If you will make more than four trips in a day, buy a 24-hour ticket in the SL app instead of tapping a card each time.
buy: SL app (the ticket shows as a QR code)
Tap a bank card at the gates and on buses
SL customer service shops
Cash is not accepted on buses
Timed tickets start at first use

bus.sum: SL runs the city buses. Blue buses are the main trunk routes and board at all doors, and red buses cover local routes. Night buses replace some metro and bus routes after hours.
bus.sched: Buses run all day, with night buses after the metro closes. Check the SL app for your route.
tickets: Same fares as the metro: 43 SEK single, valid 75 minutes
Reduced fare 26 SEK for children, teenagers, students up to 20 and seniors
A parent with a stroller rides free on red buses, but not on blue central buses
Airport coach: Flygbussarna to Arlanda 129 SEK one way
bus.tip: Carry a card or use the SL app. Cash is not accepted on buses.
buy: SL app before you board
Tap a bank card on the reader on board
SL customer service shops
Cash is not accepted on buses
Flygbussarna: online or on the bus, cards only

airport.sum: Stockholm Arlanda (ARN) is north of the city. The Arlanda Express reaches Stockholm Central in about 18 minutes. SL commuter trains take about 40 minutes.
airport.sched: The Arlanda Express runs from early morning to after midnight, about every 15 minutes at peak. SL commuter trains run about twice an hour. Flygbussarna coaches take 40 to 50 minutes.
tickets: Arlanda Express: 349 SEK adult one way, 598 SEK return. Early bird 199 SEK if booked 5 or more days ahead
Arlanda Express: 199 SEK for youth (18 to 25), pensioners and children. Children travel free with a ticket holder aged 26 or over
SL commuter train (line 41): an SL ticket plus an Arlanda station fee. The SL app shows the total
Flygbussarna coach: 129 SEK one way
Taxi to the centre: about 600 to 900 SEK
airport.tip: The Arlanda Express is the fastest. A normal SL ticket does not cover Arlanda station, so add the station fee.
buy: Arlanda Express: online, at Stockholm Central (counter or machines) and at Arlanda information desks or machines
SL commuter train: SL app, SL sales points or Arlanda Central station counter
Flygbussarna: online or on the bus
Pay the Arlanda station fee at the counter in SkyCity if it is not in your fare

metro.note: The Tunnelbana has three colour groups: blue, red and green, with 100 stations. All lines meet at T-Centralen. Many stations are decorated with art.
lines: Blue: line 10 (Kungsträdgården to Hjulsta) and line 11 (to Akalla)
Red: line 13 (Norsborg to Ropsten) and line 14 (Fruängen to Mörby centrum)
T-Centralen links all three colour groups with commuter trains
Gates accept bank cards, SL Access cards and SL app tickets

tips: A bank card tap costs 43 SEK each time. Buy a 24-hour ticket in the SL app if you make more than four trips a day.
Buy SJ tickets before you board. Tickets are not sold on trains.
The Arlanda Express is fastest at about 18 minutes. SL commuter trains add an Arlanda station fee.
Cash is not accepted on buses. The fine without a valid ticket is 1,500 SEK.
